args.title: Fix health endpoint reporting version 'dev' in production
args.body:
src/api/health.ts

Read the version from package.json directly or via an environment variable set at build/runtime rather than relying on `process.env.npm_package_version`, which is only defined when running via `npm run` (not when running `node dist/index.js` directly in production containers).
